snippet.title: Teamcrafter - Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Forge weapons, pick your lineup, and watch them win.

While brave adventurers face epic monsters, you have chosen a relaxing life.
Armed with your harvesting tools and your skill, you craft sturdy equipment to help them.

Everyone knows how to fight, but you know how to craft !

Video edited by Friday Afternoons
Music and SFX by Corentin Brasart
